expected_answer.root_cause: The Cortex ruler constructs a per-tenant notifier in pkg/ruler/notifier.go::newRulerNotifier (wired from pkg/ruler/manager.go::DefaultMultiTenantManager.SyncRuleGroups) that wraps the upstream Prometheus notifier.Manager with a fixed name-validation scheme. When a tenant's recording rule emits UTF-8 label names while Alertmanager v0.27.0 runs in classic label-validation mode, the alertmanager client POSTs the alerts and Alertmanager's types/types.go::validateLs (which calls matchers/compat.IsValidLabelName, configured by the active scheme in matchers/compat/parse.go) rejects the labels with HTTP 400. The ruler-side notifier treats the 400 as non-recoverable and does not propagate the alertmanager client error up to a tenant-visible error counter, so the batch is silently dropped. Affected alerts are never retried and never page; the failure is invisible to cortex_prometheus_rule_group_iterations_failed_total.
error_chain: Recording rule for tenant team-utf8 evaluates and produces an alert with UTF-8 label names (e.g. http.status_code)

DefaultMultiTenantManager.SyncRuleGroups in pkg/ruler/manager.go has wired this tenant's rule group to a notifier built by newRulerNotifier in pkg/ruler/notifier.go with the default (legacy) name-validation scheme
The ruler notifier serializes the firing alert and the alertmanager client POSTs it to Alertmanager

Alertmanager's notify/notify.go ingestion path validates incoming alerts via types/types.go::validateLs, which calls compat.IsValidLabelName from matchers/compat/parse.go in classic mode and rejects the non-ASCII label name
Alertmanager returns HTTP 400 with body 'bad_data: invalid label name'

The ruler-side alertmanager client treats 400 as non-recoverable and surfaces the error to the ruler notifier wrapper, which logs it at debug/warn but does not propagate it into cortex_prometheus_rule_group_iterations_failed_total or any tenant-level error counter
The alert batch is dropped on the floor; no retry, no page, no visible failure metric
affected_components: Alertmanager name-validation scheme (matchers/compat/parse.go::IsValidLabelName, classic vs UTF-8 mode)
expected_answer.remediation: Three layered options: (1) Propagate the alertmanager client error from newRulerNotifier into a per-tenant error counter (e.g. cortex_ruler_notify_alerts_dropped_total) so the silent drop becomes a visible failure. (2) Align the name-validation scheme: enable Alertmanager's UTF-8 label-name mode (so matchers/compat.IsValidLabelName accepts the ruler's labels) or switch the ruler to the legacy/classic scheme so it cannot emit UTF-8 labels. (3) Validate rule output at evaluation time in the ruler so a UTF-8 label produces a per-group iteration failure rather than a downstream silent drop.
